# Data quality expectations

`warn` keeps the row and counts the violation. `drop` removes the row from silver and writes it to the quarantine table with the rules it failed. `fail` stops the update, for contract breaks where continuing would corrupt downstream tables.

## `silver.customers`

| Expectation | Action | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id_present` | drop | `customer_id IS NOT NULL AND length(customer_id) > 0` |
| `updated_at_valid` | drop | `updated_at IS NOT NULL` |
| `country_is_iso_length` | warn | `country IS NULL OR length(country) = 2` |
| `op_present` | drop | `op IS NOT NULL` |
| `op_known` | fail | `op IS NULL OR op IN ('I', 'U', 'D')` |

## `silver.orders`

| Expectation | Action | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id_present` | drop | `order_id IS NOT NULL AND length(order_id) > 0` |
| `customer_id_present` | drop | `customer_id IS NOT NULL AND length(customer_id) > 0` |
| `amount_valid` | drop | `amount IS NOT NULL AND amount >= 0` |
| `order_ts_valid` | drop | `order_ts IS NOT NULL` |
| `updated_at_valid` | drop | `updated_at IS NOT NULL` |
| `currency_is_iso_length` | warn | `length(currency) = 3` |
| `status_known` | warn | `status IN ('new', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'refunded')` |
| `op_present` | drop | `op IS NOT NULL` |
| `op_known` | fail | `op IS NULL OR op IN ('I', 'U', 'D')` |

## `silver.payments`

| Expectation | Action | Rule |
|---|---|---|
| `payment_id_present` | drop | `payment_id IS NOT NULL AND length(payment_id) > 0` |
| `order_id_present` | drop | `order_id IS NOT NULL AND length(order_id) > 0` |
| `amount_positive` | drop | `amount IS NOT NULL AND amount > 0` |
| `paid_at_valid` | drop | `paid_at IS NOT NULL` |
| `updated_at_valid` | drop | `updated_at IS NOT NULL` |
| `method_known` | warn | `method IN ('card', 'bank_transfer', 'wallet')` |
| `op_present` | drop | `op IS NOT NULL` |
| `op_known` | fail | `op IS NULL OR op IN ('I', 'U', 'D')` |

## Bronze

Every bronze table counts rows with rescued data in `rescued_data_empty` (warn).
